'''Plasma detonators''' were [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] weapons used by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. A plasma detonator hung before the seat of each member of the [[Gungan High Council/Legends|Gungan High Council]] in [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]].
